instruction: Place an Amazon order as per my Amazon shopping list note in SimpleNote.
notes: The note's content is unknown up front, so the model assumes a shopping list with two product entries (name + quantity) and a delivery address name (Home/Work); for more entries the search_products/add_product_to_cart pair is repeated. Static init facts (on-list, product-query, note-delivery-address) stand for the information revealed by show_note; shopping-list-known gates their use. clear_cart is called once before adding items so the order contains exactly the listed products (evaluation ignores cart entries but checks order items). add_product_to_cart is blocked after the order is placed, so the goal literals (added-to-cart ...) together with (order-placed delivery-address) hold only if the items were in the cart when the order was placed. supervisor-complete-task carries the order's record entities (two distinct products with their quantities and the address) as non-API parameters so its precondition is the lifted goal; it has no answer argument. Payment card choice is unconstrained by the evaluation, so any card from show_payment_cards is used; address records are only read, never modified.
